ops.title: cc-sync phase2c FINAL-HEAD acceptance @1b20506 on synckit a99d818: e2e 20/20, realproc pass (G1/G2 skip), native unaffected

ops.body:
This run is distinct from the earlier acceptance recorded in note f6daa6f. That run was cc-sync/phase2c @ 27b1761 pinned to synckit 4334f0dd3914, and its e2e fake Network kept RestrictedEpoch at 0. This final-head run is cc-sync/phase2c @ 1b20506d83597dc2d96b08b6a31653538d7548d3, pinned to the actual final synckit head a99d818143ea881af465e3f9dfec5b05da592e35 (v0.39.3-0.20260927023451-a99d818143ea, which adds restart backoff 9f57b07 and README a99d818 on top of 4334f0d) and reposync a16167684fde (unchanged pin). All runs used GOWORK=off. Logs are at /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/deps/logs/*-final-head.log. Each log's first line names the HEAD it ran.

Commits on cc-sync/phase2c after 9549098:
- f816c00 re-pins synckit to a99d818. There were no compile breaks and no behavior change. Its subject also names reposync a161676, but that pin was already in place.
- b7a30f0 changes the e2e fixtures and adds the new test.
- 1b20506 deletes one doc comment on an unexported test helper.
The whole acceptance ran at b7a30f0 first (logs *-final-head-b7a30f0.*: e2e 20/20 ok 226.507s, both realproc runs identical to the results below). It was then re-run in full at 1b20506, which is the final head, with the results below.

Fixture changes in b7a30f0:
- internal/e2e Network.Set carries RestrictedEpoch over and advances it on every published state that is not Unrestricted, matching the resident fakeMonitor.set rule. It closes the Current channel.
- Network.Flap publishes a restriction and its clearing with no Current call between them.
- Lanes.CLI runs cc-sync with Deliveries backed by daemon.Harness.Status.
- TestPolicyPausesOnEitherEndpointAndAutoResumes now also compares net.status RestrictedEpoch.
- The new test is TestPolicyRestrictionClearedBetweenSamplesRestartsTransfer. It uses a 4 MiB blob and flaps the network at the second batch.put.
  - lanes sender: the lane pauses with local-restricted-mid-transfer. cc-sync status shows restricted-mid-transfer (local).
  - lanes receiver: the lane pauses with peer-restricted-mid-transfer. cc-sync status shows restricted-mid-transfer (peer).
  - In both lanes cases, the only call after the flapped put is the restart's svc.capabilities. There is no batch.commit, no apply.v2, no receipt, and no checkpoint on host-b before the restart. After the restart there is exactly one batch.commit and one apply.v2, the ACK matches the pending change, the receipt matches that change, and b's pickup of blob.bin is byte-exact.
  - pump receiver (Mesh.Deliver): the first Deliver gets a receiver-restricted-mid-transfer refusal and writes nothing. The second Deliver acks exactly once, with byte-exact content.
  - The test also checks the admitted epoch on the wire. Every bulk call up to and including the flapped put carries the receiver's old epoch. After a receiver flap, every later call carries epoch+1. After a sender flap, the receiver epoch stays unchanged.
- Failing-first: with publishLocked temporarily forcing RestrictedEpoch=0, all three subtests FAILED. In both lanes cases a batch.put crossed after the flap, and the pump Deliver returned nil. Log: e2e-flap-failing-first-epochless-final-head.log. The fake was then restored. The new test passed 6/6 under -race -count=6.

Gates at 1b20506: go build ./..., go vet ./..., go vet -tags e2e ./internal/e2e/, and go vet -tags realproc ./internal/realproc/ all passed. go test -race -count=1 ./... passed with 19 packages ok and 0 DATA RACE. golangci-lint run ./... reported 0 issues. A separate golangci-lint --build-tags e2e run at b7a30f0 reported 12 findings. All are in lines this change did not touch (pickup_test, fixtures, scale_test, cli.go S1016, lanes.go PendingChange G304), and that run is not a required gate.

FINAL-HEAD acceptance at 1b20506:
1. E2E (`go test -tags e2e -race -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/e2e/ -v`, git-lfs /opt/homebrew/bin/git-lfs): 20/20 top-level PASS, which is the earlier 19 plus the new test. There were 0 FAIL, 0 SKIP, and 0 DATA RACE, and the suite reported ok 148.973s. Every existing policy and transport scenario passed on the epoch-advancing fake: TestPolicyPausesOnEitherEndpointAndAutoResumes (12 subtests), TestPolicyReceiverRefusesMidBatch, TestExpiryWithoutResurrection, all TestDelivery*, and all TestScale*.
2. Realproc with REALPROC_SYNCKIT=deps/synckit-final3 (detached a99d818) and REALPROC_OLD_SYNCKIT=synckit cc-sync-recovery (9014672, read-only): TestRealProcessHost, TestInstallWithoutSynckitd, and TestVersionSkewOldSynckitd PASSED. TestCrossHostDelivery (G2) and TestInstallProbeRace (G1) SKIPPED. Result: ok 2.840s.
3. Realproc with REALPROC_SYNCKIT unset (go.mod pin a99d818): same outcomes, ok 2.738s. Neither realproc run left /private/tmp/ccs.* roots or synckitd.real processes behind.
4. Native was not re-run. `go list -deps -test -tags native ./internal/sessionrestore/` includes no synckit, reposync, or daemonkit package. Its only cc-sync dependencies are internal/claudenative and internal/sessionrestore, and neither changed between a30cb9f and 1b20506. The a30cb9f native PASS recorded in f6daa6f therefore still stands after the synckit re-pin.

No PR update was made from this lane. cc-sync/phase2c has no PR of its own, and PR#1 is cc-sync/integration. The pushes triggered only the cc-notes workflow, which was skipped, because ci.yml runs on main pushes and pull_request.
